The “Nearby devices / Local network” permission is required to reach the NAS. You can enable it in System settings › Apps › VR180 Player › Permissions.
Phone storage, SD cards and USB drives all work. Only the folder you choose is shared with the app; no storage permission or network needed.
Settings (all optional, you can start watching right away)
Not calibrated: using the screen density reported by the phone, which is usually accurate enough. Do this if the eye distance or position looks clearly off in the viewer.
%1$s · Prediction %2$.0f ms. Do this if forward slowly drifts away while watching; otherwise just long-press the screen to recenter.
In use: Cardboard defaults. You can skip this step. After putting on the viewer, fine-tune under “Lens calibration” in the player menu.
If a Bluetooth controller doesn\'t respond, use this page to see what it sends.
Skipped subfolders that couldn\'t be read: %1$d.
No videos here (videos under 100 MB are hidden).
The phone moved during the check. Lay it flat on a table, don\'t touch it, and try again.
Not enough samples. This phone may not provide a Game Rotation Vector sensor.
Horizontal drift %1$.2f°/min, saved and compensated automatically.
Drift is high: move away from speakers and magnets and test again, or use “Recenter” more often while watching.

The system\'s sensor fusion corrects the gyro\'s zero point automatically, and gravity locks up-down and sideways tilt so they don\'t drift; only the horizontal direction slowly wanders. Lay the phone flat on a table and don\'t touch it after pressing Start. The app measures the drift rate over %1$d seconds and cancels it out during playback.

Extrapolates the view from your head speed to offset the delay between sensing and display. Increase it if the image lags behind when you turn your head; decrease it if the image overshoots and springs back when you stop.
This only picks a starting point. Wherever you start, fine-tune under “Lens calibration” in the player menu after putting on the viewer; the final accuracy is the same.
Lens separation %1$.1f · Screen to lens %2$.1f · Center %3$s · k1 %4$.2f k2 %5$.2f
Place a credit card (or transit card) upright on the frame and adjust until the outline matches all four edges of the card.
Using: %1$s (auto: detected from the controller name after any key press)
Press every button and all four stick directions once; the newest entry is at the top. This page captures all keys, so tap “Back” at the top left to leave.
No signals received yet. Make sure the controller is paired and connected in system settings.
Menu open = move focus; closed: left/right = rewind/forward (hold to skip faster), up/down = previous/next video
Menu open = select, closed = play / pause
Passed to the system for volume
